universal_guidelines: Ensure high contrast for text (WCAG AA).
Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid colors or subtle patterns.
Use 'Chivo' font for headings to give an industrial look.
Sidebar must be dark (#1e3a5f) with light text.
Primary actions must use the brand Orange (#f97316) sparingly for emphasis.
Forms should be dense but readable, grouped by logical sections.
All currency values must be right-aligned in tables.
Status columns in tables should use badges.
